parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

The client generates the value of this parameter. Ensure that the value is unique among different requests.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the **RequestId** of the API request as the **ClientToken**. The **RequestId** may differ for each API request.

parameters.name: FinishWork
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the construction acceptance is completed. Valid values:
* **true**: The construction is completed and reported.
* **false**: Line O&M.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the Express Connect circuit.

parameters.name: LineCode
parameters.description: The line code of the telecommunications service provider.

parameters.name: LineLabel
parameters.description: The cable label in the data center building.

parameters.name: LineSPContactInfo
parameters.description: The O&M contact information of the line.

parameters.name: LineServiceProvider
parameters.description:
The telecommunications service provider. Valid values:
- **中国电信**
- **中国联通**
- **中国移动**
- **中国其他**

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the Express Connect circuit.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the region ID.
